title: 阿狸·九尾暮原
description: 阿狸在暮色高台上回身停步，九条白尾分层展开，深色完整行装与暖金侧光形成清楚剪影。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Ahri is an adult fox vastaya woman with long dark hair, amber eyes, upright dark fox ears, three subtle whisker marks on each cheek, and nine distinct white tails. Preserve her poised feminine face and natural heroic comic proportions. Dress her in a fully covering red-and-ivory long-sleeved travel tunic, opaque trousers, fitted boots, and restrained ornamental trim.
art_direction.scene: Show her pausing mid-walk on a broad elevated terrace, torso turning slightly toward the horizon while all nine tails form layered sweeping silhouettes behind her. One hand rests naturally at her side and the other holds a quiet unlit blue orb near the hip. Strong low sunlight cuts across rough crayon strokes, with a distant river and sparse monumental columns.
art_direction.palette: ivory tails, ink black, deep vermilion, amber and slate blue
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
